'''Overclocking''' is a state where a [[Resonator]] has lost control of their [[Forte]] as a result of overwhelming psychological stress or overexertion of their Resonance Ability. The loss of control causes the Resonator’s [[Resonance Energy]] to overflow, potentially harming both the Resonator and their surroundings.<ref name=":0">{{Quest|First Resonance}}
:'''''Baizhi:''' When a Resonator's mental capacity is overwhelmed, they may lose control of their {{Rubi|Forte|power}}, causing an overflow of Resonance energy.''
:''{{DIcon}} What happens when someone Overclocks?''
:'''''Baizhi:''' This is known as "Overclocking" and is categorized into three levels based on severity. The excess Resonance energy harms both the Resonator and their surroundings.''
:'''''Baizhi:''' In extreme cases, the excess energy can even manifest as destructive Tacet Fields.''
:'''''Baizhi:''' We have established a comprehensive Overclock diagnosis process to accurately predict potential risks of Overclocking.''</ref><ref>{{Quest|Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)}}
:'''''Changli:''' The research log mentioned that all Chronosorters were in working in an overdrive mode.''
:'''''Changli:''' —It's similar to how human Resonators experience Overclocking, they wrote.''
:''{{DIcon}} What is Overclocking?''
:'''''Changli:''' Overclocking happens when a Resonator overexerts their ability. And this researcher who wrote this suggests that it might be the key to triggering a Second Awakening.''</ref>

==Effects of Overclocking==
The exact effects of '''Overclocking''' depend on the Resonator's Forte and so the symptoms of '''Overclocking''' and the severity and type of damage it causes are unique to each Resonator.  In some cases '''Overclocking''' causes permanent changes to the Resonator's appearance and physique. It may even lead to a potential permanent transformation, though it could be reversed as one case seen in [[Camellya]] is confirmed who acknowledges her transformation was undone in time. At its worst, '''Overclocking '''can lead to the death of the Resonator and/or other people in cases where the overflowing Resonance Energy causes disasters like blizzards or large uncontrollable fires. Overclocking can also affect a Resonator's mind where language abilities degenerated. 

In some rare cases the '''Overclocking '''of one or more resonators at once has led to a formation of a new [[Tacet Field]].<ref name=":0" /> An example of this is the Tacet Field in the [[Port City of Guixu]]. It was formed as a result of a group of [[Midnight Rangers]] '''Overclocking''' during a mission there.<ref>{{Quest|We Promise, We Deliver}}
:'''''Tang Manliu:''' Back then, the Midnight Rangers who attacked the Tacet Mark core ended up creating a Tacet Field when they Overclocked. That Tacet Discord might've come from that.''</ref> There are also cases where the '''Overclocking '''and eventual death of a resonator has created a [[Sonoro Sphere]]. A Sonoro Sphere that was formed this way, will reflect the personality and emotions of its creator during their last moments. Currently there are two [[Forgery Challenge|Forgery Challenges]] that are inside Sonoro Spheres with this kind of origin: [[Forgery Challenge: Flaming Remnants|Flaming Remnants]] in Port City of Guixu and [[Forgery Challenge: Misty Forest|Misty Forest]] in [[Dim Forest]].<ref>[[Forgery Challenge: Flaming Remnants]], Dungeon Description
:''This Sonoro Sphere captures the never-ending din of countless engines, a constant soundtrack to the bustling metropolis that was once drenched in molten metal.''</ref><ref>[[Forgery Challenge: Misty Forest]], Dungeon Description
:''Maiden's tear was caged within the whispering forest. Her soul was forever detained and was tormented by scarlet thorns, which were nurtured by endless malice.''</ref>

According to Camellya, she also explains that once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, the person can no longer be cured. Camellya being an example of this as she is noted to being in a medical pod at set periods to manage her health properly, and even then experiences brief moments of pain at times which she tolerates.<ref>{{Quest|Forking Paths Among the Stars}}
:'''''Rover:''' You're on the edge of Overclocking. And you were in a medical pod before... Does this happen often?''
:'''''Camellya:''' Yeah. Oh, are you worried about me?''
:[...]
:'''''Camellya:''' And I'm good at dancing on the edge. I won't let myself Overclock that easily. But if it does happen... I'll just accept it as my fate.''
:'''''Rover:''' It's very dangerous. You know the risks, right?''
:'''''Camellya:''' Of course I do. But once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, they can't be cured, can they?''
</ref>

However, the documented reports of both [[Phrolova]] and [[Galbrena]] reveal the potential possibility of controlling one's Overclocking state. Despite the risks, it is considered that a Resonator with a considerable will, and if properly guided, Overclocking could potentially yield constructive outcomes, transforming into a power that Resonators could one day learn to wield with intent. However, such willful intent to Overclock is deemed dangerous where attempts to exploit the power gained from the action, as the [[Fractsidus]] themselves are known to do, can still lead to death and shouldn't be carelessly replicated.  

==Overclock Diagnostic Report==
Because '''Overclocking''' is dangerous to Resonators and their surroundings, scientists have developed a comprehensive diagnosis process to predict each Resonators potential risk of '''Overclocking'''.<ref name=":0" /> The diagnosis includes recommendations for preventive methods as well, such as psychological counseling and regular health checks.

==Trivia== 
*In addition to humans, animals too can have resonance abilities. This means that animals can '''Overclock''' as well. According to [[Lingyang]], this can be even more dangerous than Overclocking in humans.<ref>{{Quest|Wild Heart's Return}}
:'''''Lingyang:''' Since there are humans with Resonance Abilities...''
:'''''Lingyang:''' ...Then, could there ever be beasts with the same kind of power?''
:''{{DIcon}} That's impossible.''
:''{{DIcon}} I believe so.''
:'''''Lingyang:''' Uncontrolled emotions in human Resonators lead to {{Rubi|disasters|Overclocking}}. It's even more dangerous in beasts, as they follow instincts.''</ref>
